name: remarp-vscode
description: Author reactive presentations with the remarp markdown format

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Builds and preview scripts require workspace trust; source editing and the static text preview remain available.

commands.title: Remarp: Build and Preview Compiled HTML

remarp.buildScriptPath.description: Absolute path to remarp_to_slides.py. When set, this takes priority over automatic discovery.

remarp.scrollSync.description: Sync editor cursor position with preview slide. When enabled, clicking in the editor scrolls the preview to the corresponding slide.

remarp.ai.provider.description: Default headless AI provider in Design Studio. Uses CLI authentication on the extension host (code-server). Source is sent only when Generate with AI is clicked.

remarp.ai.timeoutSeconds.description: Headless AI request timeout in seconds. Cancellation leaves source unchanged.

remarp.ai.claude.executable.description: claude CLI command name or absolute executable path on the extension host. Not a shell command. Requires a current CLI supporting the headless flags.

remarp.ai.claude.model.description: claude model ID or alias. Empty uses the CLI default. Available models depend on your provider account; no shared catalog is assumed.

remarp.ai.claude.effort.description: claude reasoning effort. Empty uses the CLI default. Supported levels depend on the selected model and CLI version.

remarp.ai.kiro.executable.description: kiro CLI command name or absolute executable path on the extension host. Not a shell command. Requires a current CLI supporting the headless flags.

remarp.ai.kiro.model.description: kiro model ID or alias. Empty uses the CLI default. Available models depend on your provider account; no shared catalog is assumed.

remarp.ai.kiro.effort.description: kiro reasoning effort. Empty uses the CLI default. Supported levels depend on the selected model and CLI version.

remarp.ai.codex.executable.description: codex CLI command name or absolute executable path on the extension host. Not a shell command. Requires a current CLI supporting the headless flags.

remarp.ai.codex.model.description: codex model ID or alias. Empty uses the CLI default. Available models depend on your provider account; no shared catalog is assumed.

remarp.ai.codex.effort.description: codex reasoning effort. Empty uses the CLI default. Supported levels depend on the selected model and CLI version.

scripts.test:browser: npm run compile && python3 test/studio-browser.py && python3 test/preview-browser.py
